children.textContent: By using TLL, you agree to:
Tell the truth in your stories. Real trips. Real takes. No AI-generated travel reports.
Respect other travelers, the countries you write about, and Magnus 🐻‍❄.
Keep ownership of your own writing and photos. We get permission to display them; you can take them down whenever.
Not use TLL for hate, harassment, illegal stuff, or anything you wouldn't tell a curious eight-year-old.
Accept that we might edit lightly for clarity, never for tone.
If that sounds reasonable, you've already agreed in spirit. The full version is below.
("TLL," "we," "us"), operated by Nancy Carleton, based in Copenhagen, Denmark.
If you're under 16, you cannot use TLL. We require all members to be at least 16.
By creating an account, submitting a story, or even just bookmarking a piece, you accept these Terms and our
You can sign up with email + password, OR with Google. We use Memberstack to manage accounts. Your account is free, always.
You're responsible for your password and for anything done from your account. If you suspect unauthorized access, email
immediately and we'll lock the account.
You can delete your account anytime via /account → Settings → Delete Account. All your stories and submissions are removed within 30 days unless you opt to leave them anonymously published.
Don't impersonate other travelers, brands, or public figures. Pen names are allowed; identity theft is not.
When you submit a story, photo, or pet record to TLL, you grant us a

to display your content on TLL, reformat it for different screen sizes, include it in the rotation gallery and weekly digest, and show it in our marketing if it's particularly excellent (we'll always ask first for major campaigns).
TLL is a publishing venue, not a copyright transfer. You can take your content down anytime.
You choose how you're credited on every submission:
Real photos you actually took (or have the right to publish)
Real opinions about places, food, customs, layovers
Real pets you actually travel with
Stories generated by AI (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Midjourney). The byline is human or it doesn't ship.
Stories about trips you didn't take
Stock photography labeled as your own
Sponsored content disclosed as if it weren't
Hate, harassment, doxxing, or targeting individuals or groups
Illegal content under Danish or international law
Content that punches down at a country, culture, or its people

Every submission goes through: (1) an AI-assisted first read for factual flags and Editorial Charter alignment, (2) a human review by Nancy or future TLL editorial staff, and (3) a publish-or-revise decision within 48 hours.
We may edit lightly for clarity, grammar, and length. We don't change your voice. If we want a substantive edit, we'll ask you first.
All published TLL content follows the
Named travelers. Specific places at specific times.
Magnus 🐻‍❄ appears in his work only.
AI is a tool for editing, not a co-author. The byline is human.
5. What TLL is, what it isn't
TLL is a community-powered travel storytelling platform. Travelers submit, an editor curates, the library grows.
a booking platform, an influencer agency, a social network, or a travel agency.
TLL is currently free. We may add a paid tier in the future for premium features. Existing accounts will always have a free tier option. We'll never paywall existing published stories.
Stories on TLL are written by travelers. We curate, but we don't fact-check every detail. If something looks wrong, please email
Don't copy other travelers' stories or photos for use elsewhere without their permission.
with subject line "PRESS." We respond within 3 business days.
If you're a partner (tourism board, brand):
with subject "PARTNERSHIPS." All paid placements disclosed inline; we don't run hidden sponsored content.
If you believe content on TLL infringes your copyright: email
with subject line "TAKEDOWN REQUEST," include your contact info, the URL of the infringing content, identification of your work, a good-faith statement, and your signature. We act within 7 days.

We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms, submit AI-generated content disguised as personal writing, harass other travelers, or submit fraudulent content. We'll always email you first unless the violation is egregious.
You can terminate your own account anytime via /account.
TLL is provided "as is." Travel stories are personal experiences from named travelers, not professional travel advice. We make no warranties about accuracy, completeness, or fitness for any purpose.
Don't rely on TLL stories for visa requirements, medical advice, safety conditions, or legal status of destinations. Always check official sources before traveling.
To the maximum extent allowed by law, TLL is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the platform.
If you have a claim, our maximum liability is the amount you've paid TLL in the last 12 months (currently €0 for all members).
These Terms are governed by Danish law. Any disputes will be resolved in the courts of Copenhagen, Denmark.
If you're an EU consumer, you also have rights under your local consumer protection law, which we respect.
We'll update these Terms when our practices change. Material changes will be emailed to all members 30 days in advance and posted as a banner on the site.
The trips happened. The opinions are uncut. The third-act sag has been edited out.
